title: Simulation 3D Bicyclist
text: Implement bicyclist in 3D environment, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Scale}, {Initial position [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the initial bicyclist position, {Initial rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the initial angle of bicyclist rotation, {Name}, {Sample time} and {Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} sets the output location and orientation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Yaw
ports.summary: Yaw orientation angle of bicyclist scalar

params.name: Scale
params.values: Scale factor for bicyclist [1, 1, 1] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Initial rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Initial angle of bicyclist rotation [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of bicyclist SimulinkBicyclist1 (default) | bicyclist name

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: Output location and orientation of pedestrian off (default) | on
